capability_exceptions.behavior: Kimi K3 always enables thinking; requesting reasoning_level='none' cannot disable it and the adapter warns.
Kimi Chat Completions is stateless; previous_response is accepted for shared API compatibility but ignored, so callers must send the complete messages history.
The adapter rejects a forced named-tool choice before transport; Kimi documents that forcing a specific tool is incompatible with K3's always-on thinking.
The adapter rejects URL-backed ImagePart input before transport; image bytes and data URIs are sent inline.
The adapter rejects DocumentPart URLs before transport; Kimi's Files API extracts file content separately and does not attach a PDF to Chat Completions.
